findings.title: Render Tracking Infinite Loop
findings.summary: Tracking renders via atom causes infinite re-render loop

human.whatHappened: Attempted to track render count using an atom, which triggered infinite re-renders
human.whyItMatters: Demonstrates that atoms should not be updated during render phase
human.lesson: Use refs for render tracking, not reactive state

machine.fix: Use useRef for render counting instead of atom

snippets.label: Anti-pattern
snippets.code:
const renderCountAtom = Atom.make(0)
useEffect(() => { setRenderCount(c => c + 1) })

findings.title: Effect-Atom Uses Result, Not Suspense
findings.summary: Effect-Atom does NOT use React Suspense - uses Result monad instead

human.whatHappened: Expected useAtomSuspense to throw Promise like React Suspense, but Effect-Atom uses Result pattern
human.whyItMatters: Must use Result.match() with onInitial/onSuccess/onFailure handlers
human.lesson: Read the README - Effect-Atom has its own state machine for async

snippets.label: Correct pattern

findings.title: Provider Polling Cascade
findings.summary: Context provider with setInterval causes ALL children to re-render

human.whatHappened: RenderTrackerProvider used useState with setInterval, causing cascading re-renders
human.whyItMatters: Provider re-renders propagate to entire subtree
human.lesson: Use stable refs in providers, poll only in leaf components

machine.pattern:
const [, forceUpdate] = useState(0)
setInterval(() => forceUpdate(n => n + 1), 500)
machine.fix: Use useRef for stats, move polling to GlobalRenderCounter leaf

findings.title: Unconditional Stream Subscription
findings.summary: useAtomValue(streamAtom) on mount causes infinite render loop

human.whatHappened: Stream atom emits every 1s, causing component to re-render forever
human.lesson: Add pause/subscribe toggle for stream atoms

machine.fix: Guard with isSubscribed state, add toggle button

findings.title: Double Stream Subscription
findings.summary: Parent and child both subscribed to same stream, doubling renders

human.whatHappened: H3_ResultAtoms and H3_StreamResult both called useAtomValue on stream
human.lesson: Single subscription point per stream atom

machine.fix: Removed parent subscription, child is now single subscription point

findings.title: Parent Cascade Render Tracking
findings.summary: Child tracked ALL renders as stream-caused, including parent cascades

human.whatHappened: Reset Trigger button click caused h3Stream counter to increment
human.lesson: Track value changes, not just renders

machine.fix: Compare result to prevResultRef, only count when value changed

snippets.label: Fix

findings.title: Result Atom Mount Render Sequence
findings.summary: Result atoms cause Initial→Success renders on mount (expected behavior)

human.whatHappened: Multiple renders on mount: Initial state, then Success after Effect resolves
human.whyItMatters: This is EXPECTED - Result<A> transitions are state changes
human.lesson: Plan render budgets: 3-4 renders per Result atom on mount

machine.pattern: // t=0: Initial, t=~1ms: Success (sync), t=1000ms: Success (async)
machine.fix: Not a bug - documented as expected behavior

findings.title: Conditional Hook Violation
findings.summary: Conditional useAtomValue call violates Rules of Hooks

human.whatHappened: Subscribe button crashed with 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render'
human.whyItMatters: React hooks must be called in same order on every render
human.lesson: Use component boundaries to control hook lifecycle, not conditionals

machine.fix: Extract to H3_StreamValueDisplay component that mounts/unmounts

snippets.label: Fix

findings.title: Result Atom Caching (Immutability)
findings.summary: Result atoms cache forever once resolved; use Atom.family for refetch

human.whatHappened: H3.b showed stale timestamp that never updated, even after Reset Trigger
human.whyItMatters: Result atoms are immutable once resolved - this is intended behavior
human.lesson: Each atom instance is immutable. To refetch, use Atom.family keyed by trigger - new key = new atom = fresh Effect run = new immutable result

snippets.label: Before (cached forever)
After (refetchable)

findings.title: Dangling Atom Reference After Refactor
findings.summary: Renamed h3AsyncResultAtom to h3AsyncResultFamily but left dangling reference in H3_ResultAtoms

human.whatHappened: ReferenceError: h3AsyncResultAtom is not defined - app crashed on load
human.whyItMatters: Incomplete refactors break the app entirely
human.lesson: Grep before cutting - audit ALL usages across the file

snippets.label: Error
snippets.code:
ReferenceError: h3AsyncResultAtom is not defined
    at H3_ResultAtoms (EffectAtomTestbed.tsx:1475:36)

snippets.label: Grep audit
snippets.code:
grep -n 'h3AsyncResultAtom' EffectAtomTestbed.tsx
# Should return 0 results after fix

damage.rootCause: Renamed atom to family pattern but didn't audit all usages
damage.whatWasMissed: Line 1475 in H3_ResultAtoms still referenced old atom name
damage.prevention: Always grep -n 'oldName' before removing/renaming. The CLAUDE.md warning exists for this.
